repo</a> </aside>  <main> <section id="overview" class="hero"> <h2>The goal</h2> <p>Do not merely give Claude more instructions. Build a repository where <b>the right action is easy to discover, architectural mistakes are difficult to make, and failures produce actionable feedback.</b></p> <div class="note"><b>Evidence boundary:</b> this document combines the OpenAI Harness Engineering ideas discussed earlier with a concrete .NET implementation. The exact folder names, Repo Doctor, specific .NET libraries, and many implementation details are proposed adaptations—not claims that OpenAI prescribed them.</div> <div class="cards"> <div class="card"><strong>Knowledge</strong><span class="muted">Human-authored decisions + machine-generated maps.</span></div> <div class="card"><strong>Constraints</strong><span class="muted">Architecture and quality rules become executable checks.</span></div> <div class="card"><strong>Agent workflow</strong><span class="muted">Investigate → plan → implement → test → review → fix.</span></div> <div class="card"><strong>Maintenance</strong><span class="muted">Automated gardening prevents repository entropy.</span></div> </div> </section>  <h2 id="workflows">Claude's work flows</h2> <p class="muted">These are the important loops to design around. Expand the phases below to see what creates each part.</p>  <div class="diagram"> <h3>1. Investigation flow — Claude discovers before editing</h3> <div class="flow"> <div class="node">User goal</div><div class="arrow">→</div><div class="node">AGENTS.md</div><div class="arrow">→</div><div class="node">Relevant domain</div><div class="arrow">→</div><div class="node">Architecture docs</div><div class="arrow">→</div><div class="node">Generated maps</div><div class="arrow">→</div><div class="node">Existing code/tests</div><div class="arrow">→</div><div class="node">Plan</div> </div></div>  <div class="diagram"> <h3>2. Implementation flow — Claude edits the smallest correct boundary</h3> <div class="flow"> <div class="node">Plan</div><div class="arrow">→</div><div class="node">Read patterns</div><div class="arrow">→</div><div class="node">Edit code</div><div class="arrow">→</div><div class="node">Add/update tests</div><div class="arrow">→</div><div class="node">Update docs</div><div class="arrow">→</div><div class="node">Run checks</div> </div></div>  <div class="diagram"> <h3>3. Validation flow — failures feed directly back to Claude</h3> <div class="flow"> <div class="node">Changes</div><div class="arrow">→</div><div class="node">Build</div><div class="arrow">→</div><div class="node">Tests</div><div class="arrow">→</div><div class="node">Architecture</div><div class="arrow">→</div><div class="node">Quality/security</div><div class="arrow">→</div><div class="node">Agent review</div><div class="arrow">→</div><div class="node loop">Fix & repeat</div> </div></div>  <div class="diagram"> <h3>4. Maintenance flow — the repository improves itself</h3> <div class="flow"> <div class="node">Scheduled agent</div><div class="arrow">→</div><div class="node">Scan repo</div><div class="arrow">→</div><div class="node">Find drift/debt</div><div class="arrow">→</div><div class="node">Small fix PR</div><div class="arrow">→</div><div class="node">CI + review</div><div class="arrow">→</div><div class="node">Merge</div><div class="arrow">→</div><div class="node">Regenerate knowledge</div> </div></div>  <h2 id="files">How files are connected</h2> <div class="diagram"> <div class="filemap"> <div class="col"> <div class="file human"><b>AGENTS.md</b><br><span class="small">Entry point / table of contents</span></div> <div class="file human"><b>ARCHITECTURE.md</b><br><span class="small">System map + principles</span></div> <div class="file human"><b>docs/decisions/</b><br><span class="small">Why important choices were made</span></div> <div class="file human"><b>docs/execution/</b><br><span class="small">Active implementation plans</span></div> </div> <div class="col"> <div class="file generated"><b>docs/generated/</b><br><span class="small">Project graph · dependency graph · API map · DB map · routes</span></div> <div class="file generated"><b>RepoDoctor</b><br><span class="small">Repository inspection and diagnostics</span></div> <div class="file generated"><b>Skills / scripts</b><br><span class="small">Repeatable ways for Claude to investigate and act</span></div> </div> <div class="col"> <div class="file code"><b>src/</b><br><span class="small">Production code</span></div> <div class="file code"><b>tests/</b><br><span class="small">Behavior and integration tests</span></div> <div class="file validate"><b>Architecture tests</b><br><span class="small">Dependency and structural constraints</span></div> <div class="file validate"><b>CI</b><br><span class="small">Build, test, lint, docs, quality, security</span></div> </div> </div> </div>  <pre>Claude does NOT need to read the whole repository.  AGENTS.md    ↓ points to the relevant knowledge architecture / domain docs    ↓ point to the relevant boundaries generated maps    ↓ locate actual implementation source + tests    ↓ reveal existing patterns architecture checks + CI    ↓ reveal what is allowed Claude edits    ↓ feedback tells Claude what must change</pre>  <h2 id="phases">Phases</h2>  <details id="p0" class="phase" open><summary>Phase 0 — Establish the Target</summary><div class="phase-body"> <p><span class="tag">Foundation</span> Inventory the existing .NET repository before changing it.</p> <ul><li>Solution and project structure</li><li>Project references and NuGet dependencies</li><li>Target frameworks and SDK versions</li><li>API, database, EF Core, auth, configuration, integrations</li><li>Tests, CI/CD, deployment, observability</li><li>Existing architecture and documentation</li><li>Obvious drift, duplication, dead code, and technical debt</li></ul> <p><b>Output:</b> an initial repository inventory and architecture assessment.</p></div></details>  <details id="p1" class="phase"><summary>Phase 1 — Build the Repository Map</summary><div class="phase-body"> <p>Create a small root entry point rather than a giant instruction file.</p> <pre>AGENTS.md ARCHITECTURE.md docs/   architecture/   design/   product/   decisions/   execution/   generated/   quality/   references/</pre> <p><b>Claude behavior:</b> start at AGENTS.md, then follow links only into the context relevant to the task.</p></div></details>  <details id="p2" class="phase"><summary>Phase 2 — Create the Architecture Model</summary><div class="phase-body"> <ul><li>System boundaries</li><li>Applications and modules</li><li>Dependency direction</li><li>Infrastructure boundaries</li><li>Data flow</li><li>External systems</li><li>Runtime/deployment boundaries</li></ul> <p>Document both <b>what the architecture is</b> and <b>what it must not become</b>.</p></div></details>  <details id="p3" class="phase"><summary>Phase 3 — Turn Architecture into Enforceable Rules</summary><div class="phase-body"> <p>Move important architectural guidance from prose into executable checks.</p> <ul><li>Forbidden project dependencies</li><li>Namespace/module boundaries</li><li>Domain isolation</li><li>API/application boundaries</li><li>Infrastructure restrictions</li><li>Structural tests and analyzers</li></ul> <p>Example: a domain project should fail CI if it references Infrastructure.</p></div></details>  <details id="p4" class="phase"><summary>Phase 4 — Establish .NET Conventions</summary><div class="phase-body"> <p>Keep conventions focused on things that materially affect consistency and maintainability.</p> <ul><li>Names for commands, queries, handlers, services, DTOs</li><li>EF Core boundaries</li><li>API contract rules</li><li>Error handling</li><li>Logging</li><li>Async usage</li><li>Dependency injection</li><li>Testing expectations</li></ul> <p>Whenever possible, enforce the convention rather than repeatedly telling Claude about it.</p></div></details>  <details id="p5" class="phase"><summary>Phase 5 — Build the Knowledge Base</summary><div class="phase-body"> <p>Separate knowledge by purpose so Claude can retrieve only what it needs.</p> <ul><li><b>Architecture:</b> system structure and boundaries</li><li><b>Design:</b> coding/testing/security practices</li><li><b>Product:</b> domain and user intent</li><li><b>Decisions:</b> ADRs and rationale</li><li><b>Execution:</b> active and completed work</li><li><b>Quality:</b> health and known gaps</li><li><b>References:</b> external technical context</li></ul></div></details>  <details id="p6" class="phase"><summary>Phase 6 — Separate Generated Knowledge</summary><div class="phase-body"> <p><b>Human-authored:</b> why the system works the way it does.</p><p><b>Machine-generated:</b> what the repository currently contains.</p> <pre>docs/generated/   project-graph.md   dependency-graph.md   api-surface.md   ef-schema.md   routes.md   repository-map.md</pre> <p>This is how you avoid requiring humans to constantly update facts that can be derived from code.</p></div></details>  <details id="p7" class="phase"><summary>Phase 7 — Build the Documentation Generator</summary><div class="phase-body"> <p>Create a repository tool that scans the solution and regenerates derived knowledge.</p> <ul><li>.sln / .csproj files</li><li>Project references</li><li>Namespaces and public types</li><li>Endpoints/routes</li><li>EF DbContexts, entities and migrations</li><li>Dependency injection registrations</li><li>Configuration</li><li>Tests</li></ul> <p>Proposed implementation: a small .NET <b>RepoDoctor</b> or repository utility.</p></div></details>  <details id="p8" class="phase"><summary>Phase 8 — Make the Repository Self-Describing</summary><div class="phase-body"> <p>Claude should be able to answer questions such as:</p> <ul><li>What projects exist?</li><li>What depends on this project?</li><li>Where is this domain behavior implemented?</li><li>What endpoints exist?</li><li>What database objects are involved?</li><li>What tests cover this?</li><li>What architectural rules apply?</li></ul> <p>The goal is a navigable repository knowledge graph, even if implemented using ordinary files and tools.</p></div></details>  <details id="p9" class="phase"><summary>Phase 9 — Build Agent Skills</summary><div class="phase-body"> <pre>.claude/skills/   investigate/   implement/   test/   review/   architecture/   docs/   cleanup/</pre> <p>Skills should teach Claude <b>how to work in this repository</b>: where to look, what commands to run, what checks to perform, and how to finish a task.</p></div></details>  <details id="p10" class="phase"><summary>Phase 10 — Create the Investigation Workflow</summary><div class="phase-body"> <pre>Task  ↓ Identify domain  ↓ Read relevant architecture  ↓ Find existing implementation  ↓ Find related tests  ↓ Find dependencies  ↓ Find applicable constraints  ↓ Determine change boundary  ↓ Create plan</pre> <p>This prevents the common agent failure mode of editing the first plausible file it finds.</p></div></details>  <details id="p11" class="phase"><summary>Phase 11 — Create Execution Plans</summary><div class="phase-body"> <p>Plans become persistent repository artifacts instead of disappearing into a chat.</p> <pre>docs/execution/   active/     add-order-search.md   completed/   technical-debt.md</pre> <p>Plans should contain goal, current state, proposed change, affected modules, constraints, steps, and validation.</p></div></details>  <details id="p12" class="phase"><summary>Phase 12 — Build the Feedback Loop</summary><div class="phase-body"> <pre>Implement  ↓ Build  ↓ Test  ↓ Architecture checks  ↓ Lint/security/quality  ↓ Agent review  ↓ Fix  ↓ Repeat</pre> <p>The important change is that validation is part of the agent workflow rather than a final human-only activity.</p></div></details>  <details id="p13" class="phase"><summary>Phase 13 — Create a Repository Doctor</summary><div class="phase-body"> <p>A single diagnostic command can expose the repository's health.</p> <pre>Repository Health ✓ Build ✓ Tests ✓ Architecture ✓ Formatting ✓ Dependency rules ✓ Documentation links ✓ Generated docs current  Warnings ⚠ Stale documentation ⚠ Missing tests ⚠ Complexity ⚠ Technical debt</pre> <p>This is a proposed .NET adaptation, not a named component from OpenAI's article.</p></div></details>  <details id="p14" class="phase"><summary>Phase 14 — Architecture Quality Scoring</summary><div class="phase-body"> <p>Create a quality view for architecture, testing, documentation, observability, security, API consistency, dependency hygiene, and maintainability.</p> <p>Where possible, derive scores from actual checks rather than subjective manual ratings.</p></div></details>  <details id="p15" class="phase"><summary>Phase 15 — Documentation Validation</summary><div class="phase-body"> <ul><li>Validate links</li><li>Detect stale generated artifacts</li><li>Detect missing documentation</li><li>Check that referenced projects/types still exist</li><li>Run documentation checks in CI</li></ul> <p>A scheduled agent can propose updates when human-authored documentation becomes stale.</p></div></details>  <details id="p16" class="phase"><summary>Phase 16 — Automated Garbage Collection</summary><div class="phase-body"> <p>Encode architectural "golden principles" and periodically search for violations.</p> <ul><li>Forbidden dependencies</li><li>Duplicated abstractions</li><li>Stale docs</li><li>Dead code</li><li>Oversized classes</li><li>Missing tests</li><li>Obsolete patterns</li><li>Architectural drift</li></ul> <p>Have an agent create small, reviewable cleanup PRs rather than allowing entropy to accumulate.</p></div></details>  <details id="p17" class="phase"><summary>Phase 17 — Make Runtime Behavior Legible</summary><div class="phase-body"> <p>Static source is not enough. Give Claude controlled access to runtime behavior.</p> <ul><li>Start the application</li><li>Call APIs</li><li>Inspect logs</li><li>Inspect traces/metrics</li><li>Run integration scenarios</li><li>Inspect relevant runtime failures</li></ul></div></details>  <details id="p18" class="phase"><summary>Phase 18 — Create a Testable Runtime Environment</summary><div class="phase-body"> <p>For higher autonomy, give tasks isolated environments where Claude can safely run the application and tests.</p> <pre>Task worktree  ├── application  ├── test database  ├── test data  ├── logs  └── telemetry</pre></div></details>  <details id="p19" class="phase"><summary>Phase 19 — Make CI the Immune System</summary><div class="phase-body"> <div class="cards"><div class="card"><b>Build</b>Compile all projects.</div><div class="card"><b>Tests</b>Unit + integration.</div><div class="card"><b>Architecture</b>Structural constraints.</div><div class="card"><b>Quality</b>Static analysis + quality gates.</div><div class="card"><b>Docs</b>Link and freshness checks.</div><div class="card"><b>Security</b>Dependency and security checks.</div></div> </div></details>  <details id="p20" class="phase"><summary>Phase 20 — Define the Human / Agent Boundary</summary><div class="phase-body"> <div class="tree"> <div class="card"><b>Human owns</b><ul><li>Goals and priorities</li><li>Business judgment</li><li>Major architecture decisions</li><li>Security decisions</li><li>Tradeoffs</li><li>Acceptance</li></ul></div> <div class="card"><b>Agent owns</b><ul><li>Investigation</li><li>Implementation</li><li>Tests</li><li>Documentation</li><li>Refactoring</li><li>Review/fix loops</li></ul></div> </div></div></details>  <details id="p21" class="phase"><summary>Phase 21 — Increase Autonomy Gradually</summary><div class="phase-body"> <pre>1  Claude reads; human implements 2  Claude implements; human reviews 3  CI validates; Claude fixes failures 4  Claude self-reviews before human review 5  Human gives goal; Claude produces validated PR 6  Human provides direction; Claude runs the full loop</pre> <p>Do not skip levels until the repository's constraints and feedback systems are reliable.</p></div></details>  <details id="p22" class="phase"><summary>Phase 22 — Self-Maintaining Repository</summary><div class="phase-body"> <p>The final loop is continuous:</p> <pre>Human goal  ↓ Claude investigates  ↓ Claude plans  ↓ Claude implements  ↓ Repository validates  ↓ Claude reviews/fixes  ↓ Human approves meaningful decisions  ↓ Merge/deploy  ↓ Telemetry + quality signals  ↓ Maintenance agents find drift  ↓ Repository knowledge and code improve  ↓ Next task</pre> </div></details>  <h2 id="endstate">The end state</h2> <div class="diagram"> <div class="cards"> <div class="card"><strong>Human knowledge</strong><code>docs/product</code><br><code>docs/decisions</code><br><code>docs/design</code></div> <div class="card"><strong>Generated knowledge</strong><code>docs/generated</code><br>Current maps derived from code</div> <div class="card"><strong>Agent interface</strong><code>AGENTS.md</code><br><code>.claude/skills</code><br>scripts/tools</div> <div class="card"><strong>Executable specification</strong>Architecture tests<br>Analyzers<br>CI gates</div> <div class="card"><strong>Runtime feedback</strong>Tests<br>Logs<br>Traces<br>Metrics</div> <div class="card"><strong>Continuous maintenance</strong>Quality scoring<br>Documentation gardening<br>Architectural cleanup</div> </div> </div>  <div class="note"><b>Key principle:</b> Don't just tell Claude what to do. Build a repository that makes the correct action discoverable and makes incorrect actions produce immediate, machine-readable feedback.</div>  <footer> <p><b>Evidence note:</b> The conceptual ideas are based on the OpenAI Harness Engineering article discussed in this conversation. The concrete .NET file layout and tooling are implementation recommendations, not claims that OpenAI uses this exact .NET structure.</p> <p class="small">Use the left navigation and expandable phase sections as progressive disclosure: start with the overview and diagrams, then open only the phase you are implementing.</p> </footer> </main> </div> </body> </html>

      if (el){ el.click(); hpStatus.textContent = 'คลิกแล้ว ↳ ' + describeTarget(el); }       clickCooldown = 18;     } else if (!isPinching){       handCursor.classList.remove('clicking');       hpStatus.textContent = `เคอร์เซอร์นิ้ว: ซูมหน้า ${pageZoom.toFixed(2)}x`;     }     lastClickState = isPinching;     if (clickCooldown > 0) clickCooldown--;      if (typeof drawConnectors === 'function'){       drawConnectors(canvasCtx, lm, HAND_CONNECTIONS, {color:'#e6c765', lineWidth:2});       drawLandmarks(canvasCtx, lm, {color:'#fff', lineWidth:1, radius:2.4});     }   } else {     handCursor.style.opacity = '0';   }   canvasCtx.restore(); }  async function handLoop(){   if (!handsActive) return;   if (videoEl.readyState >= 2){     try{ await hands.send({image: videoEl}); }catch(e){ /* skip a dropped frame */ }   }   rafId = requestAnimationFrame(handLoop); }  async function startHandTracking(){   if (!navigator.mediaDevices || !navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia){     hpStatus.textContent = 'อุปกรณ์นี้ไม่รองรับกล้อง หรือหน้านี้ไม่ได้เปิดผ่าน HTTPS (จำเป็นบน iPad)';     return;   }   hpVideoWrap.classList.add('on');   hpStatus.textContent = 'กำลังขอสิทธิ์ใช้กล้อง...';    if (!hands){     hands = new Hands({locateFile: f => `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mediapipe/hands/${f}`});     hands.setOptions({maxNumHands:1, modelComplexity:1, minDetectionConfidence:0.6, minTrackingConfidence:0.6});     hands.onResults(onHandResults);   }    try{     // ideal (not exact) constraints + explicit front camera — avoids OverconstrainedError on iPad     mediaStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({       video: { facingMode: 'user', width: { ideal: 320 }, height: { ideal: 240 } },       audio: false     });     videoEl.srcObject = mediaStream;     await videoEl.play(); // must follow the user tap directly for iOS/iPadOS Safari     handsActive = true;     hpToggle.textContent = 'ปิดกล้อง';     hpStatus.textContent = 'พร้อมแล้ว — ยกมือขึ้นแล้วขยับดูครับ';     handLoop();   }catch(err){     hpStatus.textContent = 'ไม่สามารถเข้าถึงกล้องได้ กรุณาอนุญาตสิทธิ์กล้องใน Safari ให้เว็บนี้ (ตั้งค่า > Safari > กล้อง)';     hpVideoWrap.classList.remove('on');   } }  function stopHandTracking(){   handsActive = false;   if (rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);   if (mediaStream){ mediaStream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop()); mediaStream = null; }   videoEl.srcObject = null;   hpVideoWrap.classList.remove('on');   handCursor.style.opacity = '0';   pageZoom = 1;   if (siteZoom) siteZoom.style.transform = 'scale(1)';   hpToggle.textContent = 'เปิดกล้อง';   hpStatus.textContent = 'เลื่อนมือ = เลื่อนเคอร์เซอร์ · กางนิ้วโป้ง+ชี้ = ซูมทั้งหน้า · ชิดนิ้วชี้+กลาง = คลิก'; }  hpToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {   if (handsActive) stopHandTracking(); else startHandTracking(); }); </script> </body> </html>

</div>                      <!-- HOW THIS MODEL WORKS (ACCORDION) -->                     <div class="glass-card rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-800">                         <button onclick="toggleAccordion()" class="w-full p-4 text-left font-semibold text-xs text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider flex justify-between items-center hover:bg-slate-800/50 transition">                             <span class="flex items-center gap-2">                                 <i class="fa-solid fa-circle-info text-cyan-400"></i> How this model works                             </span>                             <i id="accordionIcon" class="fa-solid fa-chevron-down text-slate-500 transition-transform"></i>                         </button>                         <div id="accordionContent" class="hidden p-4 pt-0 text-xs text-slate-400 space-y-2 border-t border-slate-800/50">                             <p>                                 <strong>1. Normalized Category Edge:</strong> Statistics are converted to point-equivalent advantages based on relative standard deviations (e.g. 1% FG% diff ≈ 1.2 pts spread).                             </p>                             <p>                                 <strong>2. Logistic Win Probability:</strong> Margins are mapped to probabilities using the standard logistic formula:                                 <span class="block font-mono text-[11px] text-cyan-300 bg-slate-900 p-1.5 rounded my-1 text-center">P(Win) = 1 / (1 + e^(-k * Margin))</span>                                 where $k$ is calibrated according to your selected Confidence Mode.                             </p>                             <p>                                 <strong>3. Situational Adjustments:</strong> Home court (+2.5 to +3.0 pts) and lineup impact are directly added to the net margin before probability transformation.                             </p>                         </div>                     </div>                  </div>             </div>          </div>     </main>      <!-- JS LOGIC ENGINE -->     <script>         // Global State         let homeCourtState = 'teamA'; // 'neutral', 'teamA', 'teamB'         let confidenceMode = 'balanced'; // 'conservative', 'balanced', 'aggressive'         let teamAWinsL5 = 4;         let teamBWinsL5 = 3;          // Presets Data         const presets = {             celtics_bucks: {                 teamA: "Boston Celtics",                 teamB: "Milwaukee Bucks",                 teamAWins: 4,                 teamBWins: 3,                 home: "teamA",                 statsA: { ppg: 118.4, oppPpg: 108.1, rpg: 46.2, apg: 26.5, tpg: 11.8, fgPct: 48.5, fg3Pct: 38.2, ftPct: 81.5 },                 statsB: { ppg: 114.2, oppPpg: 112.5, rpg: 43.8, apg: 24.1, tpg: 13.5, fgPct: 46.8, fg3Pct: 35.5, ftPct: 77.0 },                 injury: 2.0,                 extra: 0.5             },             lakers_warriors: {                 teamA: "LA Lakers",                 teamB: "GS Warriors",                 teamAWins: 3,                 teamBWins: 4,                 home: "teamB",                 statsA: { ppg: 115.0, oppPpg: 114.2, rpg: 44.5, apg: 27.0, tpg: 13.8, fgPct: 47.9, fg3Pct: 35.8, ftPct: 77.5 },                 statsB: { ppg: 118.2, oppPpg: 115.5, rpg: 42.1, apg: 28.6, tpg: 12.2, fgPct: 47.2, fg3Pct: 38.0, ftPct: 79.2 },                 injury: -1.5,                 extra: 1.0             },             nuggets_suns: {                 teamA: "Denver Nuggets",                 teamB: "Phoenix Suns",                 teamAWins: 4,                 teamBWins: 2,                 home: "teamA",                 statsA: { ppg: 116.8, oppPpg: 109.5, rpg: 45.0, apg: 29.2, tpg: 12.0, fgPct: 49.8, fg3Pct: 37.5, ftPct: 82.0 },                 statsB: { ppg: 113.5, oppPpg: 113.0, rpg: 42.8, apg: 25.4, tpg: 13.1, fgPct: 47.5, fg3Pct: 36.8, ftPct: 80.5 },                 injury: 3.0,                 extra: 0.0             }         };          // Initialize App on DOM Load         document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {             renderWinsButtons();             setHomeCourt('teamA');             setConfidence('balanced');             calculateMatchup();         });          // Render 0-5 Win Buttons         function renderWinsButtons() {             const containerA = document.getElementById('btnGroupTeamAWins');             const containerB = document.getElementById('btnGroupTeamBWins');                          containerA.innerHTML = '';             containerB.innerHTML = '';              for (let i = 0; i <= 5; i++) {                 // Team A button                 const btnA = document.createElement('button');                 btnA.className = `flex-1 py-1 text-xs font-mono font-bold rounded transition ${teamAWinsL5 === i ? 'bg-cyan-500 text-navy-900' : 'bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:border-slate-700'}`;                 btnA.innerText = i;                 btnA.onclick = () => { teamAWinsL5 = i; renderWinsButtons(); calculateMatchup(); };                 containerA.appendChild(btnA);                  // Team B button                 const btnB = document.createElement('button');                 btnB.className = `flex-1 py-1 text-xs font-mono font-bold rounded transition ${teamBWinsL5 === i ? 'bg-amber-500 text-navy-900' : 'bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:border-slate-700'}`;                 btnB.innerText = i;                 btnB.onclick = () => { teamBWinsL5 = i; renderWinsButtons(); calculateMatchup(); };                 containerB.appendChild(btnB);             }              document.getElementById('valTeamARecord').innerText = teamAWinsL5;             document.getElementById('valTeamBRecord').innerText = teamBWinsL5;         }          // Home Court Selector Toggle         function setHomeCourt(mode) {             homeCourtState = mode;             const btnNeutral = document.getElementById('btnHomeNeutral');             const btnA = document.getElementById('btnHomeTeamA');             const btnB = document.getElementById('btnHomeTeamB');              [btnNeutral, btnA, btnB].forEach(btn => {                 btn.className = "py-1.5 rounded transition text-center text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-800";             });              if (mode === 'neutral') {                 btnNeutral.className = "py-1.5 rounded transition text-center font-bold bg-slate-800 text-white border border-slate-700";             } else if (mode === 'teamA') {                 btnA.className = "py-1.5 rounded transition text-center font-bold bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-400 border border-cyan-500/30";             } else if (mode === 'teamB') {                 btnB.className = "py-1.5 rounded transition text-center font-bold bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30";             }             calculateMatchup();         }          // Confidence Mode Selector Toggle         function setConfidence(mode) {             confidenceMode = mode;             const btnCons = document.getElementById('btnConfCons');             const btnBal = document.getElementById('btnConfBal');             const btnAgg = document.getElementById('btnConfAgg');              [btnCons, btnBal, btnAgg].forEach(btn => {                 btn.className = "py-1.5 rounded transition text-center text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-800";             });              if (mode === 'conservative') {                 btnCons.className = "py-1.5 rounded transition text-center font-bold bg-slate-800 text-slate-200 border border-slate-700";             } else if (mode === 'balanced') {                 btnBal.className = "py-1.5 rounded transition text-center font-bold bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-400 border border-cyan-500/30";             } else if (mode === 'aggressive') {                 btnAgg.className = "py-1.5 rounded transition text-center font-bold bg-slate-800 text-slate-200 border border-slate-700";             }             calculateMatchup();         }          // Main Calculation Engine         function calculateMatchup(userTriggered = false) {             // 1. Get Team Names             const nameA = document.getElementById('teamAName').value.trim() || "Team A";             const nameB = document.getElementById('teamBName').value.trim() || "Team B";              // Update UI Team Labels             document.getElementById('headerTeamA').innerText = nameA;             document.getElementById('headerTeamB').innerText = nameB;             document.getElementById('labelTeamARecord').innerText = nameA;             document.getElementById('labelTeamBRecord').innerText = nameB;             document.getElementById('dispTeamAName').innerText = nameA;             document.getElementById('dispTeamBName').innerText = nameB;              // 2. Fetch Numeric Inputs             const getVal = (id) => parseFloat(document.getElementById(id).value) || 0;              const statsA = {                 ppg: getVal('teamA_ppg'),                 oppPpg: getVal('teamA_oppPpg'),                 rpg: getVal('teamA_rpg'),                 apg: getVal('teamA_apg'),                 tpg: getVal('teamA_tpg'),                 fgPct: getVal('teamA_fgPct'),                 fg3Pct: getVal('teamA_fg3Pct'),                 ftPct: getVal('teamA_ftPct')             };              const statsB = {                 ppg: getVal('teamB_ppg'),                 oppPpg: getVal('teamB_oppPpg'),                 rpg: getVal('teamB_rpg'),                 apg: getVal('teamB_apg'),                 tpg: getVal('teamB_tpg'),                 fgPct: getVal('teamB_fgPct'),                 fg3Pct: getVal('teamB_fg3Pct'),                 ftPct: getVal('teamB_ftPct')             };              const netInjury = parseFloat(document.getElementById('sliderNetInjury').value);             const extraMatchup = parseFloat(document.getElementById('sliderExtraMatchup').value);              document.getElementById('valNetInjury').innerText = (netInjury >= 0 ? `+${netInjury}` : `${netInjury}`) + " pts";             document.getElementById('valExtraMatchup').innerText = (extraMatchup >= 0 ? `+${extraMatchup}` : `${extraMatchup}`) + " pts";              // 3. Normalized Weights             const rawWScoring = getVal('w_scoring');             const rawWShooting = getVal('w_shooting');             const rawWRebound = getVal('w_rebound');             const rawWTurnover = getVal('w_turnover');             const rawWForm = getVal('w_form');              const totalRawWeights = rawWScoring + rawWShooting + rawWRebound + rawWTurnover + rawWForm;                          const normWScoring = rawWScoring / totalRawWeights;             const normWShooting = rawWShooting / totalRawWeights;             const normWRebound = rawWRebound / totalRawWeights;             const normWTurnover = rawWTurnover / totalRawWeights;             const normWForm = rawWForm / totalRawWeights;              document.getElementById('lblWeightScoring').innerText = Math.round(normWScoring * 100) + "%";             document.getElementById('lblWeightShooting').innerText = Math.round(normWShooting * 100) + "%";             document.getElementById('lblWeightRebound').innerText = Math.round(normWRebound * 100) + "%";             document.getElementById('lblWeightTurnover').innerText = Math.round(normWTurnover * 100) + "%";             document.getElementById('lblWeightForm').innerText = Math.round(normWForm * 100) + "%";              // 4. Calculate Sub-Differentials (From Team A's perspective)             // Scoring Diff: (A Net Rating Diff)             const netRatingA = statsA.ppg - statsA.oppPpg;             const netRatingB = statsB.ppg - statsB.oppPpg;             const scoringEdgePts = netRatingA - netRatingB;              // Shooting Edge Pts (1% FG diff ~ 1.2 pts, 1% 3P diff ~ 1.0 pts, 1% FT diff ~ 0.4 pts)             const shootingDiff = (statsA.fgPct - statsB.fgPct) * 1.2 +                                   (statsA.fg3Pct - statsB.fg3Pct) * 1.0 +                                   (statsA.ftPct - statsB.ftPct) * 0.4;              // Rebound Edge Pts (1 rpg ~ 0.8 pts)             const reboundEdgePts = (statsA.rpg - statsB.rpg) * 0.8;              // Turnover Edge Pts (Lower TPG is better -> (TPG_B - TPG_A) * 1.2 pts)             const turnoverEdgePts = (statsB.tpg - statsA.tpg) * 1.2;              // Form & Home Court Edge Pts             let homePts = 0;             if (homeCourtState === 'teamA') homePts = 2.8;             if (homeCourtState === 'teamB') homePts = -2.8;              const formEdgePts = ((teamAWinsL5 - teamBWinsL5) * 1.5) + homePts;              // 5. Total Weighted Point Spread / Margin (Favors Team A if positive)             // Standard multiplier scales composite index into realistic NBA point spread             const totalWeightedMargin =                  (scoringEdgePts * normWScoring * 2.2) +                 (shootingDiff * normWShooting * 1.8) +                 (reboundEdgePts * normWRebound * 1.8) +                 (turnoverEdgePts * normWTurnover * 1.8) +                 (formEdgePts * normWForm * 2.0) +                 netInjury + extraMatchup;              // 6. Logistic Win Probability Mapping             // Slope parameter k adjusts for confidence mode             let k = 0.17; // Balanced             if (confidenceMode === 'conservative') k = 0.11;             if (confidenceMode === 'aggressive') k = 0.23;              const probA = 1 / (1 + Math.exp(-k * totalWeightedMargin));             const probB = 1 - probA;              const probAPct = (probA * 100).toFixed(1);             const probBPct = (probB * 100).toFixed(1);              // Estimated Total Points (Sum of averages adjusted slightly for pace balance)             const estTotal = ((statsA.ppg + statsB.oppPpg + statsB.ppg + statsA.oppPpg) / 2).toFixed(1);              // 7. Update Prediction Dashboard UI             document.getElementById('winProbA').innerText = probAPct + "%";             document.getElementById('winProbB').innerText = probBPct + "%";             document.getElementById('barWinProbA').style.width = probAPct + "%";             document.getElementById('barWinProbB').style.width = probBPct + "%";              // Spread Display             const marginAbs = Math.abs(totalWeightedMargin).toFixed(1);             let spreadText = "";             let favoriteName = "";              if (totalWeightedMargin > 0.2) {                 spreadText = `${getShortName(nameA)} -${marginAbs}`;                 favoriteName = `${nameA} Favored`;                 document.getElementById('favoriteTag').className = "text-cyan-400 font-bold";             } else if (totalWeightedMargin < -0.2) {                 spreadText = `${getShortName(nameB)} -${marginAbs}`;                 favoriteName = `${nameB} Favored`;                 document.getElementById('favoriteTag').className = "text-amber-400 font-bold";             } else {                 spreadText = "PICK 'EM (EVEN)";                 favoriteName = "Even Matchup";                 document.getElementById('favoriteTag').className = "text-slate-400 font-bold";             }              document.getElementById('dispSpread').innerText = spreadText;             document.getElementById('dispMarginRaw').innerText = `(Margin: ${totalWeightedMargin >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${totalWeightedMargin.toFixed(1)} pts)`;             document.getElementById('dispTotal').innerText = estTotal;             document.getElementById('favoriteTag').innerText = favoriteName;              <!-- Update Edge Breakdown Sub-bars -->             updateBreakdownBars(statsA, statsB);              <!-- Update Key Advantage Badges -->             renderCategoryBadges(nameA, nameB, statsA, statsB);              <!-- Generate Dynamic Summary Text -->             generateSummaryText(nameA, nameB, probAPct, probBPct, totalWeightedMargin, statsA, statsB, netInjury, homePts);         }          // Helper: Get Short Acronym/Name         function getShortName(name) {             const parts = name.trim().split(" ");             if (parts.length > 1) {                 return parts[parts.length - 1].substring(0, 3).toUpperCase();             }             return name.substring(0, 3).toUpperCase();         }          // Render Visual Breakdown Sub-Bars         function updateBreakdownBars(statsA, statsB) {             // Net Scoring             const netA = statsA.ppg - statsA.oppPpg;             const netB = statsB.ppg - statsB.oppPpg;             const diffScoring = netA - netB;             document.getElementById('diffScoringVal').innerText = (diffScoring >= 0 ? `+${diffScoring.toFixed(1)} ppg` : `${diffScoring.toFixed(1)} ppg`);             document.getElementById('diffScoringVal').className = diffScoring >= 0 ? "font-mono text-cyan-400" : "font-mono text-amber-400";             setBarRatio('barDiffScoringA', 'barDiffScoringB', netA + 30, netB + 30);              // FG%             const diffFg = statsA.fgPct - statsB.fgPct;             document.getElementById('diffShootingVal').innerText = (diffFg >= 0 ? `+${diffFg.toFixed(1)}%` : `${diffFg.toFixed(1)}%`);             document.getElementById('diffShootingVal').className = diffFg >= 0 ? "font-mono text-cyan-400" : "font-mono text-amber-400";             setBarRatio('barDiffShootingA', 'barDiffShootingB', statsA.fgPct, statsB.fgPct);              // Rebounds             const diffRpg = statsA.rpg - statsB.rpg;             document.getElementById('diffReboundVal').innerText = (diffRpg >= 0 ? `+${diffRpg.toFixed(1)} rpg` : `${diffRpg.toFixed(1)} rpg`);             document.getElementById('diffReboundVal').className = diffRpg >= 0 ? "font-mono text-cyan-400" : "font-mono text-amber-400";             setBarRatio('barDiffReboundA', 'barDiffReboundB', statsA.rpg, statsB.rpg);              // Turnovers (Inverted: lower TPG is better)             const diffTpg = statsB.tpg - statsA.tpg; // positive = Team A has fewer turnovers             document.getElementById('diffTurnoverVal').innerText = (diffTpg >= 0 ? `+${diffTpg.toFixed(1)} care` : `${diffTpg.toFixed(1)} care`);             document.getElementById('diffTurnoverVal').className = diffTpg >= 0 ? "font-mono text-cyan-400" : "font-mono text-amber-400";             setBarRatio('barDiffTurnoverA', 'barDiffTurnoverB', 20 - statsA.tpg, 20 - statsB.tpg);         }          function setBarRatio(idA, idB, valA, valB) {             const safeA = Math.max(1, valA);             const safeB = Math.max(1, valB);             const total = safeA + safeB;             const pctA = ((safeA / total) * 100).toFixed(1);             const pctB = (100 - pctA).toFixed(1);              document.getElementById(idA).style.width = pctA + "%";             document.getElementById(idB).style.width = pctB + "%";         }          // Render Category Badges         function renderCategoryBadges(nameA, nameB, statsA, statsB) {             const container = document.getElementById('badgeContainer');             container.innerHTML = '';              const categories = [                 {                     label: "Scoring Net",                     winner: (statsA.ppg - statsA.oppPpg) >= (statsB.ppg - statsB.oppPpg) ? nameA : nameB,                     isTeamA: (statsA.ppg - statsA.oppPpg) >= (statsB.ppg - statsB.oppPpg)                 },                 {                     label: "Perimeter 3P%",                     winner: statsA.fg3Pct >= statsB.fg3Pct ? nameA : nameB,                     isTeamA: statsA.fg3Pct >= statsB.fg3Pct                 },                 {                     label: "Glass / RPG",                     winner: statsA.rpg >= statsB.rpg ? nameA : nameB,                     isTeamA: statsA.rpg >= statsB.rpg                 },                 {                     label: "Ball Security",                     winner: statsA.tpg <= statsB.tpg ? nameA : nameB, // Lower TPG wins                     isTeamA: statsA.tpg <= statsB.tpg                 }             ];              categories.forEach(cat => {                 const badge = document.createElement('div');                 badge.className = `px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg border text-[11px] font-medium flex items-center justify-between ${                     cat.isTeamA                          ? 'bg-cyan-500/10 border-cyan-500/30 text-cyan-300'                          : 'bg-amber-500/10 border-amber-500/30 text-amber-300'                 }`;                 badge.innerHTML = `                     <span class="text-slate-400 truncate">${cat.label}</span>                     <span class="font-bold ml-1 flex items-center gap-1">                         <i class="fa-solid fa-caret-right text-[10px]"></i> ${getShortName(cat.winner)}                     </span>                 `;                 container.appendChild(badge);             });         }          // Generate Dynamic Takeaway Text         function generateSummaryText(nameA, nameB, probA, probB, margin, statsA, statsB, netInjury, homePts) {             const favName = margin >= 0 ? factors.slice(0, 2).join(" and ") : "overall metric efficiency";              const summary = `<strong>Key Takeaway:</strong> ${favName} holds a projected win probability of <strong>${favProb}%</strong> with an estimated margin of <strong>${absMargin} points</strong>. This edge is primarily driven by ${factorStr}.`;                          document.getElementById('summaryText').innerHTML = summary;         }          // Load Preset Data         function loadPreset(key) {             const data = presets[key];              // Populate Stats B             document.getElementById('teamB_ppg').value = data.statsB.ppg;             document.getElementById('teamB_oppPpg').value = data.statsB.oppPpg;             document.getElementById('teamB_rpg').value = data.statsB.rpg;             document.getElementById('teamB_apg').value = data.statsB.apg;             document.getElementById('teamB_tpg').value = data.statsB.tpg;             document.getElementById('teamB_fgPct').value = data.statsB.fgPct;             document.getElementById('teamB_fg3Pct').value = data.statsB.fg3Pct;             document.getElementById('teamB_ftPct').value = data.statsB.ftPct;              document.getElementById('sliderNetInjury').value = data.injury;             document.getElementById('sliderExtraMatchup').value = data.extra;              setHomeCourt(data.home);             calculateMatchup();         }          // Reset to Defaults         function resetData() {             loadPreset('celtics_bucks');         }          // Accordion Toggle         function toggleAccordion() {             const content = document.getElementById('accordionContent');             const icon = document.getElementById('accordionIcon');              // Copy to clipboard using standard fallback             const dummy = document.createElement("textarea");             document.body.appendChild(dummy);             dummy.value = summaryString; Таймер автоматически ориентируется именно        на московское время, поэтому человеку не нужно        выставлять часовой пояс вручную.     ========================================================= */       function getMoscowDateParts() {          const formatter =             new Intl.DateTimeFormat(                 "en-US",                 {                     timeZone: "Europe/Moscow",                      year: "numeric",                     month: "numeric",                     day: "numeric",                      hour: "numeric",                     minute: "numeric",                     second: "numeric",                      hour12: false                 }             );           const parts =             formatter.formatToParts(new Date());           const result = {};           parts.forEach(part => {              if (part.type !== "literal") {                  result[part.type] =                     Number(part.value);             }          });           return result;     }        /* =========================================================        ПОЛУЧАЕМ СЛЕДУЮЩИЕ 07:42 ПО МОСКВЕ     ========================================================= */      function getTargetTime() {          const now =             getMoscowDateParts();           /*             Создаём время 07:42 сегодняшнего             московского дня.              Date.UTC используется специально,             потому что Москва = UTC+3.         */           let target =             Date.UTC(                 now.year,                 now.month - 1,                 now.day,                 4,                 42,                 0             );           /*             04:42 UTC = 07:42 Москва.              Если 07:42 сегодня уже прошло,             ставим таймер на следующие 07:42.         */           if (target <= Date.now()) {              target += 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;         }           return target;     }       let targetTime =         getTargetTime();        /* =========================================================        ОБНОВЛЕНИЕ ТАЙМЕРА     ========================================================= */      function updateTimer() {          const difference =             targetTime - Date.now();           /* Если время закончилось */          if (difference <= 0) {              hoursElement.textContent = "00";             minutesElement.textContent = "00";             secondsElement.textContent = "00";               showReady();               return;         }           const totalSeconds =             Math.floor(                 difference / 1000             );           const hours =             Math.floor(                 totalSeconds / 3600             );           const minutes =             Math.floor(                 (totalSeconds % 3600) / 60             );           const seconds =             totalSeconds % 60;           hoursElement.textContent =             String(hours).padStart(2, "0");           minutesElement.textContent =             String(minutes).padStart(2, "0");           secondsElement.textContent =             String(seconds).padStart(2, "0");     }        /* =========================================================        ПОКАЗЫВАЕМ "ЗАРАБОТАЛ"     ========================================================= */      function showReady() {          waitingScreen.style.display =             "none";          readyScreen.style.display =             "flex";     }        /* =========================================================        ЗАПУСК ТАЙМЕРА     ========================================================= */      updateTimer();       setInterval(         updateTimer,         250     );        /* =========================================================        КНОПКА "ТЫК СЮДА"     ========================================================= */      document         .getElementById("openLetter")         .addEventListener(             "click",             function() {                  readyScreen.style.display =                     "none";                  waitingScreen.style.display =                     "none";                   letterPage.style.display =                     "block";                   /*                     Возвращаем человека                     в самое начало письма.                 */                  window.scrollTo({                     top: 0,                     behavior: "instant"                 });                   /*                     Перезапускаем анимации текста,                     чтобы они точно проигрались.                 */                  const paragraphs =                     document.querySelectorAll(                         ".letter-text"                     );                   paragraphs.forEach(                     paragraph => {                          paragraph.style.animation =                             "none";                          /*                             Небольшая задержка нужна,                             чтобы браузер понял,                             что анимацию надо запустить заново.                         */                          void paragraph.offsetWidth;                          paragraph.style.animation =                             "";                     }                 );             }         );  </script>  </body> </html>
